description: This Java class, 'TestRailLifecycleHook', is a test hook used in Cucumber tests to automatically report test results to TestRail after each scenario execution. It leverages Spring for dependency injection and integrates with TestRail via 'TestRailClient'. The class is annotated with Lombok annotations for boilerplate reduction and logging.

classes.name: TestRailLifecycleHook
classes.description: A Cucumber test hook that executes after each test scenario to report the result to TestRail if enabled.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Method invoked after each Cucumber scenario; if TestRail integration is enabled, it retrieves the TestRail client bean and saves the scenario result.
